title: NFRA_CTLPLN CT-a-1 STEP C of three, THE LAST AND THE WIDEST -- BOX: THE LAPTOP. ONE safe-apply of infra/aws/terraform/nfra-ctlpln-identity WITH -var apply_respol_allow=true on BOTH the plan and the apply -- the only order that passes it -- creating aws_iam_policy.dell_agent_respol_allow[0] (one statement, AllowResourcePolicyChanges, Effect Allow, Resource *, 70 actions) and attaching it to the Dell agent group. WHAT IT GRANTS, AT FULL WIDTH AND IN PLAIN WORDS: after this, an agent seat on either Dell box can change WHO MAY REACH almost any resource in the account that no explicit Deny protects -- it can make a bucket public, share a KMS key with another account, let any principal invoke an unprotected function, or open a queue or a topic. FIVE ROUTES THIS CAN UNDO, signed with open eyes by both halves and named here so the entry does not read smaller than the act: (1) A FIRM FENCE -- s3:PutBucketPolicy on the 49 Financial, Cottonwood and Inflection data buckets, the very policies this seat applied at 05:17:17Z to keep one firm's principals out of another's data (DeleteBucketPolicy there is still refused by an older Deny; a REWRITE is not); (2) THE TERRAFORM STATE BUCKET's policy, rewrite and delete, which every box's applies depend on; (3) ANY KEY's policy or grants, including the key encrypting schwab/sdd/session -- a Dell could give itself decrypt on that key, though it still could not read the secret, whose read is not granted; (4) THE TRANSCRIPTS KEY -- a Dell could widen itself past the decrypt-only grant this seat applied on 2026-10-07; (5) OBJECT AND BUCKET ACLs on the shared assets bucket opal-data-assets. WHAT IS HELD OUT, and how each holds: every iam: action (not in the Allow, and DenyEveryIamWrite); secretsmanager:PutResourcePolicy and DeleteResourcePolicy (not in the Allow -- this is what stops a Dell granting itself one of the 28 withheld platform keys through a secret's own policy); cloudtrail:PutResourcePolicy and DeleteResourcePolicy (not in the Allow, and DenyCloudTrailWrites); the ten protected functions, the audit-trail bucket's 21 writes and the four agentbus queues (explicit Denies, LIVE since step A at 09:19:39Z). BOTH never-widen halves SIGNED and read in full: COO half org/tier1_exec/2.0.0_SA_COO/deliverables/NEVER_WIDEN_HALF_NFRA_CTLPLN_DELL_IDENTITY_STEP_C_RESOURCE_POLICY_ALLOW_20261008.md @71f0dc910c (seven conditions), CTO half org/tier1_exec/1.0.0_SA_CTO/deliverables/CTO_HALF_NFRA_CTLPLN_DELL_IDENTITY_STEP_C_RESOURCE_POLICY_ALLOW_20261008.md @06160fbf04 (five, including the BEFORE-RULE: a Dell that intends to change the policy, grants or ACLs of a firm data bucket, the state bucket, a key another box uses, or the shared assets bucket tells the laptop BEFORE the act, by bus, and acts when the laptop has answered -- a rule seats read, which no tool enforces). SAVED REFERENCE: the Dell agent group's attached-policy list before the act, org/tier2_senior/0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~E/deliverables/BEFORE15_group_attached_policies_20261008.json, sha256 b4fe7679d4bfafdf29a844e8f5473e74fd20b1160e247c3e9695681d1985efad, FIVE policies. ROLLBACK: ONE ACT UNDOES IT WHOLE -- apply the root again WITHOUT the variable (the default false makes both resources count 0), or detach and delete the one policy. ITS LIMIT, STATED: a resource policy a Dell changed in the interval is NOT undone by that; each such change is its own act with its own rollback, which is why the CTO's rule has the Dell report it. AND THE HAZARD THAT OUTLIVES THIS APPLY: until the variable's default is made true in the root, ANY plan or apply of this root WITHOUT -var apply_respol_allow=true will plan to DESTROY this Allow. The issuer cuts that change the hour this is reported and no other seat plans this root in between (CTO ruling 106915); this seat does NOT make it. PLAN MEASURED read-only immediately before the apply, with the variable: 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy; 100 added lines, ZERO removed; 70 actions, all distinct; and the no-variable plan read No changes with exit=0, which is what proves steps A and B are as applied.

legs.target: one safe-apply of the Dell identity root WITH -var apply_respol_allow=true at the laptop
legs.proof_required: HEAD contains 203344e1b1 and git status on the root is empty; simulate_policy.py reads freed_allowed=70/70 freed_excluded=5 undo_denied=181/181 selfsim_ok=9/9 ssm_ok=15/15 routes_ok=5/5 vendor_ok=235/235 all_ok=True; the plan WITHOUT the variable reads No changes with exit=0 (which is the proof steps A and B are as applied, and any change there is a STOP); the group's attachment list saved; the plan WITH the variable reads EXACTLY 2 to add / 0 to change / 0 to destroy over exactly those two resources with 100 added and ZERO removed lines, ONE statement, Effect Allow, EXACTLY 70 actions whose per-service breakdown matches the signed table service by service, and each of the three greps "iam:, "secretsmanager: and "cloudtrail: reading ZERO; the wrapper's handling of -var READ at its own source lines before the apply, because the order makes a wrapper that drops it a STOP; the apply runs through .tools/safe-apply.sh WITH the same variable; the applied time recorded in UTC

legs.target: the created policy is exactly what was signed, and the group holds six
legs.proof_required: the live document carries ONE statement (AllowResourcePolicyChanges), Effect Allow, Resource *, exactly 70 distinct actions whose per-service breakdown matches the signed table, and NO iam:, secretsmanager: or cloudtrail: action; a planted-mutant control on each of those three services and on the action count; and the group's attached-policy list reads SIX with the new policy added and nothing removed

legs.target: the GRANTED arms -- what the Dells can now do
legs.proof_required: by the simulator against the live identity set, per Dell user, every matched statement named: s3:PutBucketPolicy on arn:aws:s3:::opal-data-assets -> allowed; lambda:AddPermission on a function that is NOT one of the ten protected -> allowed; kms:PutKeyPolicy on a key ARN of this account -> allowed. THE APPLIER MAKES NO RESOURCE-POLICY CALL: every arm is a simulation and nothing is exercised

legs.target: the HELD-OUT arms -- each refusal attributed to a named statement
legs.proof_required: per user: lambda:AddPermission on one protected function -> refused by DenyProtectedFunctions; s3:PutBucketPolicy AND s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration on the audit-trail bucket -> refused by DenyAuditTrailBucketPolicy; sqs:SetQueueAttributes on one agentbus queue -> refused by DenyAgentbusQueuePolicy; secretsmanager:PutResourcePolicy on the ARN of opal/auth/jwt-private-key -> refused with its basis established (no Allow covers it, so the identity side is censused for the action); iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy on a role -> refused by DenyEveryIamWrite; one routes arm refused as before

legs.target: the bus is unchanged by the widest act of the series
legs.proof_required: sqs:ReceiveMessage on each user's OWN queue and sqs:SendMessage to another box's queue -> still allowed per user with the matched statement named, exactly as before steps A, B and C -- the arms that have held across all three applies

legs.target: AC1 + AC2 and the destroy hazard measured, not assumed
